lines.text: Ouch! You tripped on the playground and got a bright red scrape!
Deep inside your bloodstream, emergency sirens begin to wail!
Millions of tiny disc-shaped builders called platelets rush to the rescue!
They stick together tightly, locking arms like a superhero shield wall!
Then they weave tough sticky threads called fibrin to trap red cells!
In just a few hours, the net dries into a tough, protective brown scab!
Underneath the scab roof, fresh new skin cells grow happy and smooth!
Your amazing body can heal itself from the inside out every single time!
Celebrate your body's superpowers—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
